item.title: Version 1.12.0-beta (94)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.12.0-beta (94)

  • A new photo starts blank.
  • Colour, crop, style, effects, caption, frame, and logo stay on the photo where you made them.
  • Opening, dropping, or moving to the next photo does not bring that edit along.
